chunks: And ʿAlī, peace be upon him, said:
Beware of debt, for it is worry at night and humiliation during the day.

key_terms.إِيَّاكُمْ: beware; a forceful warning to avoid something
key_terms.الدَّيْنَ: debt; financial liability owed to others
key_terms.بِاللَّيْلِ: at night; a time when anxiety and concern become more intense
key_terms.بِالنَّهَارِ: during the day; in one's outward and public dealings
key_terms.ذُلٌّ: humiliation; loss of dignity and social hardship
key_terms.هَمٌّ: worry; inner anxiety and mental burden

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام warn people against debt?
ai.summary: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام warns against falling into debt because of its heavy emotional and social burden. It brings inward anxiety and outward disgrace, making it a matter of both personal distress and public hardship.
